U.note: Classic ring timer with tabs, start/reset/skip and editable lengths, accurate end-time countdown and auto phase switch, but tabs lack ARIA and there is no live region or timer role.

V.note: Huge clear clock with good keyboard and screen-reader support, but overbuilt with two reset buttons, two-press confirms, notifications and verbose status text, and plain styling.

W.note: Handsome serif card, but the giant pomodoro-count numeral outranks the actual countdown, which sits small below it, and the persistence, settings panel and pips overbuild a simple timer.

X.note: Full-bleed colour per phase with a huge clock, clear primary Start, progress bar, shortcuts and live announcements; a few extras (presets, undo toast) but still reads as one clear timer.

Y.note: Tiny, tidy ring timer that works with tabs, skip and settings, though it has no ARIA or live region, a thin ring and Reset that also reverts to the current mode only.

Z.note: Bold full-screen red focus view with a giant clock and phase label, role=timer, live announcements, tabs as non-interactive indicators; solid but with extras like reset confirmation and sessionStorage restore.
